title: Hellenistic reconstruction from later copy
request: Reconstruct a lost Hellenistic Greek marble ruler statue from a later Roman copy, historically informed.

body_transformation.anatomy_change: none unless explicitly stated in request
body_transformation.artistic_stylization: only when selected by body mode/art method

intentional_hybrids: modern reconstruction using later-copy evidence while preserving uncertainty about the lost original

art.variant: reconstruction should distinguish secure copy evidence from uncertain original details

director.moment: neutral study view of a modern reconstruction informed by surviving copy evidence
director.action: full standing ruler portrait with restrained gesture; do not invent missing attributes without evidence
director.body_weight: stable contrapposto only if supported by the source type
director.hand_logic: hands simplified into stone-safe gestures; no unsupported thin fingers
director.material_response: newly carved reconstruction marble with no fake archaeological weathering
director.micro_story: the image communicates a proposed reconstruction, not a magically recovered original
